# Code of conduct

House follows the [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/), the same code of conduct Light uses for its SDK (the full text is in [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) at the root of this repo).

In short: be kind and honest, respect different viewpoints, give and take feedback gracefully, and take responsibility for what you say and do. Harassment, insults and personal attacks aren't welcome here.

## Reporting

That root file's reporting section is for Light's own spaces. **For this repo**, contact the maintainer, [@zachgrosser](https://github.com/zachgrosser), privately: by email at the address on that GitHub profile. You can also use GitHub's **Report content** option on any comment, issue or pull request.

Reports are kept confidential. The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close issues, or block people who don't follow this code.
